items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Title Page

items.text: Perform toward your husband all duties God's Word requires of a wife.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Title Page
items.quote: the wiues dutie towards her Husband

items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Title Page

items.text: Perform toward your parents all duties God's Word requires of children.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Title Page

items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Title Page

heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: Dedication

items.text: Further the souls of your household to salvation, as one charged by God.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: the Lord hauing giuen them the charge of so many soules to be furthered to saluation

items.text: Reform yourself first, that you may rightly reform your household.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: they must likewise be diligent and carefull to reforme themselues... otherwise, they may iustly say... Phisitian healc your selfe

items.text: Plant God's religion in your household.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: by planting Gods religion in his familie

items.text: Resolve with Joshua: I and my household will serve the Lord.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: I and my familie will serue the Lord

items.text: Resolve with Esther: I and my maids will serve the Lord.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: I and my maides will do the like

items.text: Be faithful and obedient to God yourself, so that your household may be faithful and obedient to you.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: How can any maister of a houshold... looke to haue his familie trustie and faithfull vnto him, and yet he himselfe is faithlesse to God?

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Establish an order in your house for the service of God: prayers and thanksgivings morning and evening, before and after meals.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: he must set an order in his house for the seruice of God; to wit, that morning and euening, before meales, and after meales, prayers and thankes may be offered vnto God

items.text: Use the means of household religion to make your servants the servants of God.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: these men vsed more meanes to make their seruants the seruants of God, then men do now a dayes

items.text: Teach your children the way of the Lord, that the Lord may bring upon you what he has spoken.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: I know that he will commaund his sonnes, and his houshold after him, that they keepe the way of the Lord, to do righteousnesse and iudgement

items.text: Appoint set times for the household to pray together, and do not leave it to each one privately.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: he appointed set times of praying together, and sacrificing, and commanded his children to come prepared thereunto.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Do not put her away because she is an infidel, irreligious, or of a corrupt religion; instead call upon God and live in his fear, in faithfulness, in patience, with discretion and godly counsel, labouring to win her.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: he that is snared and matched with such a wife... must call vpon God, and liue in his feare, in faithfulnes, in patience, with discretion & godly counsell, labouring to win her from the same.

items.text: Instruct and order her mind, diligently and courteously apply thyself to weed away by little and little the noysome weeds out of her mind, both by wholesome and godly precepts, and by Christian conversation.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: if he shall vse like diligence to instruct and order her minde, if he diligently and courteously apply himselfe to weede away by little and little the noysome weeds out of her mind, both by wholesome and godly precepts, and by Christian conuersation

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Require duties of your household not only by telling and admonishing, but also by correcting those who are negligent or contemptuous in practicing them.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT
items.quote: not onely by telling of them what they must do... but also by correcting them, if they shall be negligent and contemptuous

items.text: Correct not to wreak your anger or revenge yourself, but in zeal for God's glory and love to the offender, to reclaim them from evil.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT
items.quote: not to wreck and reuenge thine anger... but in zeale of Gods glory... and in loue to the party

items.text: Correct only for real faults, and for lesser faults use gentle admonition before rebuke or chastisement.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT
items.quote: there must be no rebuking, much lesse chastising, but where there is a fault... a gentle admonition may serue

items.text: Carry out correction with wisdom and patience, considering the nature of the fault, circumstances, and the mind of the offender.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT
items.quote: correction must be Wisedome, and Patience

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Worship God with your whole household, and when you are absent on necessary occasions, appoint someone meet by wit and age to do it reverently.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: he built an altar to God, where God should be worshipped ioyntly in his familie.

items.text: Catechize your children at home in a plain and familiar manner; train them in doctrine and holy precepts drawn from the word.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: Traine them vp in doctrine and holy precepts, drawne out-of the word.

items.text: Since servants spend their strength for your profit, seek the salvation of their souls by instructing them in religion.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: oughtest not thou then to seeke the saluation of their soules?

items.text: Acquaint your household with the Scriptures by reading them daily in their hearing and directing them to mark plain things according to their capacity.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: acquainting them with the Scriptures, by reading them daily in thy house in their hearing

items.text: Prepare your household for the public ministry of the word and sacraments, examine what they have learned, and call them to practice it.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: diligent care and regard that they profit by the publike ministery of the word and Sacraments

items.text: Use examples of God's past and present works of mercy and justice to encourage trust and fear in your household.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: vse of Gods workes, either past, or present: as of examples of his mercie and goodnes, to be encouraged by them to trust in him

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Compel all in your household—children and servants—to keep the Lord's Day holy, not resting only but sanctifying it in worship.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: they should be compelled to sanctifie the Lords day

items.text: Provide the means of worship for your household: see that the Word is preached where you dwell, bring children and servants to public worship, and cause them to spend the rest of the day in private godly exercises.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: they must not onely come themselues to the place of common-prayer, but bring these also with them, and spend the rest of the day in all priuate godly exercises

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Be diligent in your calling and personally oversee your goods and servants, so that you may provide for your family and not bring them to poverty.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: Be diligent to know the state of thy flocke, and take heed to thy heards... he willeth men not to trust all to seruants... but to looke diligently to them themselues.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Govern and discipline your children for their good, not for your own profit, so that they may walk in order and receive God's blessing.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: If maisters then or parents do not gouerne, but let seruants and children do as they list, they do not onely disobey God, and disaduantage themselues, but also hurt those whom they should rule.

items.text: Govern and restrain your servants for their good, not for your own profit, so that they may walk in order and receive God's blessing.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: If maisters then or parents do not gouerne, but let seruants and children do as they list, they do not onely disobey God, and disaduantage themselues, but also hurt those whom they should rule.

items.text: Govern your wife by a rule suited to a wife, not as you would a child or a servant.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: There is one rule to gouerne the wife by, another for children, another for seruants.

items.text: Seek to have Christian holiness in your dwelling, not just civil order and worldly comfort, so that God may be glorified.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: they must seeke to haue holinesse found in their habitation, whereby God may be glorified, as well as riches gotten.

items.text: Govern those under you with comeliness and decency, avoiding lordliness that is unmeet and familiarity that breeds contempt.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: Lordlinesse is vnmeete in an houshold gouernment, and yet familiaritie with such as are vnder gouernment breedeth cōtempt.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Provide for your children so that you do not leave them to the wide world when God removes you.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: they shall not be constrained to leaue their children to the wide world, which thing nature bindeth a man to haue a care of.

items.text: First provide necessaries for housekeeping before trimming up your house.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: Prepare thy worke without, and make readie thy things in the field, and afterward thou mayest build thine house.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Command your children to keep the way of the Lord, to do righteousness and judgment.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: he will commaund his sonnes... that they keepe the way of the Lord, to do righteousnesse and iudgement.

items.text: Cause your children to keep holy the Sabbath, that they may walk in the way that has promises of this life and the life to come.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: cause their children... to keepe holy the Sabbath... that they might walke in that way which hath the promises of this life, and the life to come.

items.text: Oversee your servants so that they serve God, especially in sanctifying the Sabbath.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: diligently to ouersee the wayes of their families, that they serue God... especially in sanctifying the Sabbath.

items.text: Look to your servants that they come to church, attend attentively, and spend the rest of the day profitably.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: do not once looke to their household, whether they come to Church or no... nor how they spend the rest of the day.

items.text: Do not set your servants to work or play on the Sabbath, nor encourage them by your own evil example or words.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: set them to worke, or play... do encourage them thereunto by their owne ill example and words.

items.text: Further your servants in the service of God, not treating them as mere beasts for your own profit.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: to be furthered by them in the seruice of God: but vse them more like beasts then men.

items.text: Do not reward servants only with earthly benefits, but ensure they serve the Lord, lest they lose the everlasting reward.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: when hauing bestowed some earthly benefite vpon them... make them lose the euerlasting reward.

items.text: Remember you must give an account for the souls of your household, and do not let them perish through your neglect.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: they will giue an account for their soules, which otherwise might perish through their default.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Have only one wife, and keep faith with her alone; do not put her away except for fornication.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: let none trespasse against the wife of his youth

items.text: Have only one husband; let no other man be your own.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: Let euery man haue his owne wife, and euery woman her owne husband

items.text: Punish your child if he or she makes a marriage contract with more than one person.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: it may and ought to be broken; yea, seuerely punished by parents and Magistrates

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Provide that your household may live under an ordinary ministry of the Word, or arrange that on the Sabbath and other times they attend where it is preached.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: prouide that they may liue vnder an ordinary ministery of the word, or else to take order that they resort to such places where they may haue the word ministred

items.text: Take order that everyone in your charge sanctifies the Lord's Day as well as you do yourself.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: every one should in his seueral place and roome, to take order that so many as be committed to his charge should sanctifie the Lords day, as well as himselfe

items.text: Bring up your children in the instruction and information of the Lord.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: Parents are also commanded to bring vp their children in the instruction and information of the Lord.

items.text: See that religion and holiness are actively practiced in your family, not just thrift and good husbandry.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: religion must be stirring in Christian families, & that good gouernment looketh to bring godly behauiour into families, as well as thrift and good husbandry.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Bring your servants to the preaching of the word.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: how can they be blamelesse, who seldome or neuer bring their seruants to the preaching of the word?

items.text: See that the whole household is ready to attend church together, not each man when he will.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: cause the whole familie to be in a readinesse to attend vpon them too and fro the Church, and that they should go together.

items.text: Come together with the household to church; do not come scattered and lag behind.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: the seuerall housholds, come not together, but scattered, and one dropping after another

items.text: Care for your servants' souls as for their bodies, and be willing to spare them for the worship of God.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: were as carefull for the soules of their seruants, as they are for their bodies, and did esteeme it more for their worship & credit that their seruants were religious

items.text: Do not impose work that causes continual breach of the Sabbath.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: both maister and seruant may suspect, that he is in such a calling as is not agreeable to Gods word

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Manage the household with wise, careful, and discreet forethought, making the most of what God has provided, so that all is well ordered and employed to a good end.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: good husbandrie and good huswiferie, consisteth not so much in hauing much or little, as in the wise, carefull, discreet, & good fore-casting of that which God in mercy hath enabled and enriched them with

items.text: Follow your calling with diligence, wisdom, and discretion; seek counsel and avoid rash haste, that the household may prosper.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: let him not disdaine to aske aduice and counsell... take heed of hastinesse, headinesse, and selfe-will

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Love her as his own flesh.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: to loue his wife as his owne flesh

items.text: Govern her in all duties that properly concern the state of marriage, in knowledge, wisdom, judgement, and justice.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: to gouerne her in all duties, that properly concerne the state of marriage, in knowledge, in wisedome, iudgement, and iustice.

items.text: Dwell with her.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: to dwell with her

items.text: Use her in all due benevolence honestly, soberly, and chastly.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: to vse her in all due beneuolence honestly, soberly, and chastly.

items.text: In all reverence and humility, submit and subject herself to her husband in all such duties as properly belong unto marriage.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: in all reuerence and humilitie, to submit and subiect her selfe to her Husband

items.text: Be an help unto him, according to God's ordinance.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: therein to be an helpe vnto him, according to Gods ordinance.

items.text: Obey his commandments in all things which he may command by the authority of an husband.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: to obey his commandements in all things, which he may command by the authoritie of an Husband.

items.text: Give him due benevolence.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: to giue him 〈◊〉 beneuolence.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Seek the consent and allowance of your parents before you contract marriage; it is material and necessary.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: The last point is the consent and allowance of their parents: which though it be very materiall and necessary

items.text: Do not consent to a marriage that is not meet and free, for such a contract is void and you will be punished.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: if the parents should yeeld their consent to their children, being neither meete nor free... both parents and children are to be punished.

items.text: Be bound to your spouse alone; do not contract with any other, for that would be adultery.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: euery one either betrothed or maried, is bounden and tied from contracting with any other; for that were nothing else but to promise grosse and beastly adultery.

items.text: If you promised marriage while under age, when you come of age supply what was lacking to the full contentment of all who have interest in you.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: if that (being come to yeares of discretion and state of mariage) they do not by wisedome and religion supply all that was wanting in their former rash attempt, to the full contentation of all that haue interest in them.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Be frugal and sparing, cutting your coat according to your cloth, so that your household is maintained within your means.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: a good gouernour of a familie, for the better maintenance of his familie, must be frugal, or (to speake english) a good husband, that is, spating and sauing

items.text: Do not be niggardly or stingy when the Lord requires you to open your hand for good uses.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: Yet we would not haue him pinching, or niggardly, and so dried vp for liberality, that nothing should be wrong from him for good vses.

items.text: Refrain from spending on pride and vain glory; hold fast where only lusts and pomp bid you draw.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: where nothing but vnruly lusts and pompe, or vaine glory, bid him draw, there is he to hold fast

items.text: Allow your servants enough food and drink, of good quality; do not pinch them while spending lavishly on yourself.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: Many misers pinch their seruants in their meate and drinke, allowing them not enough, or not good enough

items.text: Avoid love of mirth and pastime, for they bring loss of time, neglect of business, and needless expense.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: Loue not mirth and pastime, for they haue oft occasion of expences. Againe, they cause losse of time, and neglect of businesse at home

items.text: Do not indulge daintiness or choiceness in diet; wholesome food is cheaper and healthier.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: a sweete tooth, and a faire mouth, that is daintinesse, or choicenesse in diet, is an enemy to frugalitie

items.text: Avoid gluttony and drunkenness, which bring disease, loss of time, and poverty.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: the destiny of the drunkard and the glutton, namely, that many euils, and namely pouertie, shall betide them

items.text: Do not spend on companions, taverns, or good fellowship what belongs to your own family.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: it maketh thee lauish in spending... and spend that vpon others, which belongeth to thine owne family

items.text: Avoid costly friendship with great men that requires lavish apparel, housing, and banquets, for it will drain your resources.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: He that desireth familiarity with great men, must haue other things suteable; as costly apparell, well trimmed houses, often inuitings to bankets

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Live with her discreetly, according to knowledge.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: liue with his wife discreetly, according vnto knowledge.

items.text: Do not be bitter, fierce, or cruel to her.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: be not bitter, fierce, and cruell vnto her.

items.text: Love, cherish, and nourish her as your own body, and as Christ loved the church and gave himself for it.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: loue, cherish, and nourish his wife, euen as his owne body, and as Christ loued the Church, and gaue himselfe for it, to sanctifie it.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Do not betroth or marry without the consent of your parents (or those who stand in their place); without their consent the contract is null and the marriage would be adultery.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: wanting their consents, though in other respects neuer so good, is a meere nullity, & cannot be accomplished without the manifest breaches of the institution, and guilt of adulterie.

items.text: Exercise your authority over your children's marriages: give or withhold consent as God commands, and do not give them to ungodly spouses.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them, neither giue thy daughter vnto his sonne, nor take his daughter to thy sonne.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Comfort and suffer with one another when visited with contagious diseases, as you are one body.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: they must one comfort and suffer with the other, as they are now one bodie, &c.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Look to your family: be sure they sanctify the Lord's Day as you do.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: it is their bounden dutie thus to looke to their families, and to be sure that they sanctifie the Lords day as well as themselues

items.text: Do not go ahead without your wife; call her to go together with you to public worship.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: the husband going first out of the doores, saith to the wife, Make hast, and come assoone as you can; but here is no saying: Come let vs go

items.text: Call your children to serve God and see that they sanctify the Sabbath.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: their husbands, their fathers, and their maisters do not call vpon them to serue God, and see them sanctifie the Sabbath

items.text: Call your servants to serve God and see that they sanctify the Sabbath.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: their husbands, their fathers, and their maisters do not call vpon them to serue God, and see them sanctifie the Sabbath

items.text: After public worship, see that your household spends the rest of the day in holy exercises: examine them on the sermon, cause them to confer, and appoint Scripture reading and psalm singing.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: looke vnto them, that they spend the rest of the day in holy exercises so much as may be, examining them in that which they haue heard

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Do not correct before the fault is evident; wait for a fitter opportunity, and toward some pass over faults to let them amend of their own accord.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: Wisedome therefore will winke at a fault a while, and make as though she saw it not, that she may haue a fitter opportunitie to correct

items.text: Do not reproach or taunt him with his fault, but minister correction in love, seeking to cure his sore and salve his credit.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: wisedome will neuer reproch the offender, by reuiling or taunting him with the fault, but minister correction in loue

items.text: Avoid partiality; deal with all in the same case in the same manner.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: wisedome will auoid partialitie, and deale with all in the same case, after the same manner.

items.text: Be patient; do not fight or chide before the fault is made manifest, but hear the offender's defense and judge it by equity.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: by patience one must heare what the offender can say in his defence, and not disdaine to heare him modestly alledging for himselfe

items.text: Do not be bitter or angry in correction, lest you provoke him to anger rather than amendment.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: This patience will also keepe a man from bitternesse, which might sooner make the partie angrie, then draw him to amendment

items.text: Rebuke him sharply for a fault, measured according to its nature; do not make vain threats, but perform what you threaten if no amendment.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: threatenings must not be vaine words without effect, but alwayes if amendment follow not, thou must performe what was threatned

items.text: Chastise him with the rod when correction is deserved; do not spare out of fond pity, for that is hatred.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: He that spareth the rod hateth his sonne: but he that loueth him, chasteneth him betimes.

items.text: Do not bring up a servant delicately; correct him, for a servant will not be chastised with words.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: He which bringeth vp his seruant delicately from his youth, at length will be depriued of his children.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Honor and esteem a wife of higher birth more than your equal or one of meaner parentage, and in public appearances treat her as your superior.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: more to honour and esteeme of her, then of his equall, or of one of meaner parentage, and ... to hold her his superiour

items.text: Acknowledge that by nature you are subject to your husband, whatever your birth.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: she ought to consider ... for by nature woman was made mans subiect

items.text: Treat your wife as a fellow and companion of your life, not as a slave or servant.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: he also ought to weigh, that matrimony maketh equall many differences: and further, that he hath not taken her for a slaue or seruant, but for a fellow and companion of his life.

items.text: Seek and follow the good advice and direction of your parents in choosing a spouse, and do not be rash or hasty.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: yong folkes ought not to be too rash and hastie in their choise, but to haue the good aduice and direction of their parents and trustie friendes in this behalfe

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: Dedication

items.text: Practice catechizing and daily holy exercises in your house, and reform your household according to the Word of God.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: practise at home catechising in their houses

items.text: Bring up your children in the nurture and fear of the Lord, using all good means and offering them to the Lord, not merely providing food and clothing.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: bring them up in the nurture and feare of the Lord

items.text: Catechize and train your servants in godliness, not thinking it enough to pay them their wages.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: if Parents and Housholders shall performe no further dutie to their children and seruants, then to prouide for them, meate, drinke and apparell, and to pay them their wages

items.text: Obey and reverence your father as conscience and bounden duty require.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: obedience, that reuerence, that faithfulnesse, and that dutifulnes

items.text: Be obedient and faithful to your husband.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: obedience, that reuerence, that faithfulnesse, and that dutifulnes

items.text: Be faithful and dutiful to your master.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, Dedication
items.quote: obedience, that reuerence, that faithfulnesse, and that dutifulnes

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Love your wife constantly; do not grow cold after enjoying her, for such a one is a beast and no man.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: That husband that loueth not his wife after that he hath enioyed her for a season, but doth waxe feeble and cold... is a very beast and no man

items.text: Defend your wife's estimation with love and benevolence.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: the husband doth defend his wiues estimation, with loue and beneuolence

items.text: As head, do not be the cause of discord; either gently correct her faults or patiently bear with them, for if you fail, you are more to blame.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: the man is more to be blamed then is the woman, because that he being the chiefe ruler and head, doth not purge and remedie her of that vice

items.text: Maintain concord with your wife, for when you two are at debate, the household cannot be at rest.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: the houshold, when their maister and their mistresse, or dame, are at debate, can no otherwise be in quiet and at rest

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Love your wife as yourself and as your own body.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: Let euery one loue his wife as himselfe

items.text: Defend and keep her from all injuries and evils as your own body, not abusing or despising her.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: most louingly defend and keepe her from all iniuries, and all euils as his owne body

items.text: Rule and guide her with discretion for her good and preservation, not with force or wilfulness.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: rule her with discretion, for her good and preseruation, and not with force and wilfulnesse to intreat her

items.text: Be her defender, instructor, teacher, and comfort.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: to be her defender, instructer, teacher, and comfort

items.text: When she offends, patiently and mildly admonish her; do not hate or quarrel with her.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: he may nor hate her or quarrell with her, but patiently and mildly admonish her

items.text: Do not love her less for her infirmities, but comfort her more and help bear her burdens.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: a good husband will not take occasion to loue his wife lesse for her infirmities, but comfort her more for them

items.text: Endeavor that your wife loves you more than she fears you.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: He ought therefore to endeauour, and more force himselfe, that his wife may loue him, then that she may feare him.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Establish and maintain godly order in the house, seeing that all within its doors perform the exercises of religion.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: These be the duties that the chiefe of the familie oweth to them of his familie within doores, as touching godlinesse.

items.text: Correct your children with the rod of discipline to save them from destruction.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: God hath put the rod of correction in the hands of the Gouernours of the family, by punishment to saue them from destruction.

items.text: Set an example of ready submission to all good and Christian orders.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: in her selfe to giue example to her houshold of all readie submission to all good and Christian orders.

items.text: Order household affairs carefully so that no exercise of religion is hindered, especially in your husband's absence.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: that no exercise of religion be hindred, or put out of place, at such time as they should be done in her husbands absence.

items.text: Help your husband in spying out evils that are breeding, that by his wisdom they may be prevented or cured.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: to helpe her husband in spying out euils that are breeding, that by his wisedome they may be preuented or cured.

items.text: Instruct the younger in good things.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: Saint Paul requireth, that wiues, specially the elder, be teachers of good things, and that they instruct the yonger.

items.text: Train up your children in the seeds of religion and godliness while they are young.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: Mothers may also powre good liquor into their childrens tender vessels... sow in their mindes the seede of religion and godlinesse.

items.text: Provide food and raiment for yourselves and all your charge, and care for their health with rest, recreation, and tending in sickness.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: They must take order for prouision for necessaries... Also care must be had of the health of such as be in their families.

items.text: Have an honest calling and follow it diligently, that it may bring in gain to provide for your family.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: That euery one should haue some honest and good calling, and should walke diligently in it.

items.text: See that the good orders appointed by your husband are observed.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.
items.quote: to see good orders obserued as he hath appointed.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Be not fierce, rigorous, hasty, or disordered with her, but govern with patience and wisdom.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: he be not fierce, rigorous, hastie, nor disordered

items.text: Do not use or entreat her as a handmaid or servant, but as a fellow.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: The wife is not to be vsed or intreated as a handmaid or seruant, but as a fellow.

items.text: When she is angry, suffer her until the heat cools, then mildly admonish her; use discretion, not chiding, for a discreet word sufficeth the wise.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: after the heate is somewhat cooled, and the flame quenched, then mildly to admonish her

items.text: At the beginning of marriage, use all good means to win her good liking; avoid brawling and quarreling especially when newly married.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: at the beginning of their marriage, the wise and discret husband ought to vse all good meanes to winne the good liking of his wife towards him

items.text: Seek not only the use of her body, but possess her will and affections; be well married and live Christianly together.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: The husband ought not to be satisfied with the vse of his wiues body, but in that he hath also the possession of her will and affections

items.text: If any unkindness happen between you and your wife, do not impart it to any neighbor.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: neither of them ought to impart, or to make it knowne vnto any one of their neighbours

items.text: Admonish her often, give her good instructions, reprehend her seldom, never lay violent hands on her; if she is good, favor her; if she is shrewish, mildly suffer her.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: admonish her often, and to giue her good instructions, to reprehend her seldome, neuer to lay violent hands on her

items.text: Be not sour, currish, or unpleasant in behavior; speak fair and be cheerful, so that your wife may love you.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: their countenance is so lowring, their company so currish, that they seeme angry, euen when they are best pleased; they cannot speake faire; scarce will they laugh

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Before marriage, be betrothed to her by a solemn covenant before witnesses, promising to marry her unless lawful hindrance arise.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: This betrothing, is a couenant betweene the parties to be married... whereby they giue their troth, that they will, and shall marrie together.

items.text: Having betrothed yourself to her, keep your troth and marry her, unless some lawful unmeetness or disliking hinder it.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: they giue their troth, that they will, and shall marrie together, except some lawfull vnmeetnesse and disliking each other do hinder it.

items.text: Treat a betrothed maidservant as your own daughter: do not sell her to a strange people; if your son marries her, do not diminish her food, clothing, or the recompense for her virginity.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: her maister shall haue no power to sell her... he shall deale with her as with his owne daughter.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Seek your parents' consent before contracting marriage.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: the consent of the parents is to be demanded

items.text: After betrothal, appoint a suitable day for the marriage, neither too near nor too far off.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: to set and appoint the day of marriage, neither too neare nor too farre off

items.text: Keep your betrothal promise: marry the one to whom you have plighted your troth when your parents appoint.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: till such time I take thee for my onely betrothed wife; and thereto plight thee my troth

items.text: During betrothal, abstain from the marriage bed and behave wisely, chastely, lovingly, and soberly until the wedding day.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: abstaine from the vse of marriage, and to behaue themselues wisely, chastly, louingly, and soberly

items.text: Instruct your household diligently in the fear of God and keep it under godly discipline.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: instructeth it diligently in the feare of God, and keepeth it in good and godly discipline

items.text: Render true obedience to your husband.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: rendring true obedience to her husband

items.text: Keep a careful eye on your household, servants, and children.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: hauing a carefull eye vpon her family, seruants and children

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Live with her in the fear of God, in all modesty and sobriety.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: keepe themselues together in the feare of God, and in all modestie and sobrietie.

items.text: Use the marriage bed with prayer and soberness, not with immoderate or excessive lust.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: they may make their marriage polluted and defiled, if they vse it without prayer and sobernesse

items.text: Refrain from her company during her menstrual period, as the law commands.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: forbeare the company of his wife, when it is with her, as it is common to women
items.conflict: Ceremonial purity law; not a moral obligation for new-covenant believers (Col 2:16).

items.text: Take her as God's lawful remedy against fornication and uncleanness.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: the wife might be a lawfull remedy to auoide whoredome, fornication, and all filthy vncleane lusts

items.text: Help and comfort her in sickness, affliction, and all household cares and troubles.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: the one may helpe & comfort the other, in sicknesse, in affiction, and in all houshold cares and trouble

items.text: Make godliness the foundation of your friendship, that your companionship may be stable and steadfast.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: godlinesse of right holdeth the chiefe place: for there is no stable and stedfast friendship, vnlesse it haue his beginning from God

items.text: Cultivate virtue and honest behavior to bring mutual delight to your life together.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: Vertue and honest conditions breede mutuall delight betweene man and wife.

items.text: Bear with her weaknesses and faults, covering them by mutual forbearing.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: Mutuall forbearing, whereby we take in good worth one anothers conditions and faults is very needfull.

items.text: Love her and do not be too sharp-sighted in spying her faults, but cover them with love.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: not to be too sharpe-sighted, in spying into one anothers fauits: but that many things either they mark not, or if they marke them, they couer them with loue.

items.text: Perform your duty to her godly, carefully, and cheerfully, so the marriage yoke is light and sweet.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: Dutie performed godlily, caresully, and cheerefully on both sides, maketh the marriageyoke light and sweet.

items.text: Do not speak spitefully or indiscreetly against your wife; she is ordained as a helper, not a hinderer.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: such like sayings, tending to the dispraise of women, some maliciously and vndiseretly do vomit out, contrarie to the minde of the holy Ghost, who saith, that she was ordained as a helper

items.text: Govern her with discretion and good government, so that she may be a helper and not a hinderer through your fault.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: if they be otherwise, it is for the most part, through the fault, and want of discrerion, and lacke of good gouernment in the husband.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Live with your wife according to knowledge, honoring her as the weaker vessel, and bear with her infirmities.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: the husband must liue with his wife according to knowledge.

items.text: Give your wife due benevolence, and do not defraud her, except by mutual consent for a time of fasting and prayer.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: Let the husband giue vnto the wife due beneuolence

items.text: Love your wife, and do not be bitter, fierce, or cruel toward her.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: Husbands loue your wiues, and be not bitter vnto them.

items.text: Love your wife as Christ loved the church, and as your own body, nourishing and cherishing her.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: so ought men to loue their wiues as their owne bodies

items.text: Do not neglect or despise your wife because she is weak; since you are co-heirs of the grace of life, care for her all the more.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: she ought to be so much the more cared for.

items.text: Avoid brawling and chiding with your wife, because they hinder prayer and the service of God.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: all brawlings and chidings must be eschued and cast away, because they hinder prayers

items.text: Do not let the sun go down on your anger; never sleep in displeasure with your wife.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: neuer suffer himselfe nor his wife to sleepe in displeasure.

items.text: If you must reprove your wife, do it privately and in meekness; cover her smaller faults.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: couer faults, and winke at them, if they be not too great and intollerable.

items.text: Bear losses patiently, even if they come through your wife's negligence, and do not take offense at every trifle.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife
items.quote: take it patiently, and beare it cheerefully: yea, though the same should come partly through his wiues negligence

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Love and honour her as one whom God has honoured and Jesus Christ redeemed, a co-heir with you of everlasting life.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: let him loue and honour her ... she is, together with her husband, co-heire of life euerlasting.

items.text: Regard her frailty as a precious but brittle vessel, and treat her with gentleness and discretion.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: the husband should haue such regard of the frailtie of his wife, that he may beare with her, and intreate her with gentlenesse and discretion.

items.text: Bear with her discreetly, lest strife and contention hinder your prayers.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: lest otherwise through their strife and contention, their prayers ... be letted and interrupted.

items.text: Reprove her offences against God, but gently and by persuasion rather than force.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: it is meete that the husband should reproue his wife louingly, rather by perswasion then by force.

items.text: Diligently remove the occasion and stone at which she stumbles and takes grief.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: the husband must seeke diligently to remoue the occasion and stone whereat his wife stumbleth, and taketh occasion of griefe.

items.text: Take heed you be not tainted with the same vice you reprove, but lead her by example of the contrary virtue.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: he himselfe be not tainted with the same vice which he reproueth in his wife ... by giuing her example by the contrarie vertue

items.text: Never reprove her before others; keep reproof private, lest she be brought into contempt.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: it should neuer be done in the presence of moe then themselues.

items.text: Often admonish, seldom reprove, and never strike her.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: Often to admonish: seldome to reproue: and neuer to smite her.

items.text: Either take away her infirmities or bear with them, making yourself more virtuous.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: the infirmities of his wife, must be either taken away, or borne witball ... he that can beare with them, maketh himselfe better, and more vertuous.

items.text: Command her not as a master commands a servant, but as the soul governs the body, for her benefit and contentment.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: the husband is not to command his wife in such manner as the maister his seruant, but as the soule doth the body ... tend to reioyce and content her.

items.text: Remember she was made from your rib, not head or foot, so that she should walk jointly with you under your headship.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: God created the woman, not the head ... neither of Adams foote ... but he tooke her out of the rib, that she might walke ioyntly with him, vnder the conduct and gouernment of her head.

items.text: Give thanks to God for her as your helper, and use marriage well for comfort and salvation, not abuse it to destruction.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: render thanks, and ... vse it well, to his owne comfort and saluation: and not to abuse it.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Watch by fervent and earnest prayer to God that the devil prevail not against you by early disagreement.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: diligently watch, by seruent and earnest prayer to God, that the diuel preuaile not against them

items.text: Be very careful that your first dwelling together be loving, delectable, and friendly, and not separated through any spiteful contention or discord.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: be very carefull and diligent, that their first cohabitation and dwelling together be louing, delectable, and friendly

items.text: Learn betimes to be acquainted with her nature and condition, and apply yourself to her, loving her so that you can give her anything you have, even your own life if need require.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: learne betime to be acquainted with the nature and condition of the other, and to apply themselues according to the same ... euen their owne life if need require.

items.text: Nourish this new love and union of mind with benign, sweet, and gentle conversation until it is so increased and fastened that no great storm can dissolve it.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: nourished, with benigne, sweete, and gentle conuersation, vntill it be so increased and fastened

items.text: Shun all suspicion, especially at the beginning of marriage; do not feign suspicion or conceive it from light occasions, and give no ear to appearances.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: all suspition must be at all times, but especially at the beginning of matrimony, eschewed and shunned

items.text: Speak kindly and cheerfully to her, and draw her on with sweet and gentle words of love.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: speake kindly and cheerefully one to the other ... draw on one another with sweet and gentle words ofloue

items.text: Give her her dutiful name and title, and eschew the contrary, that you may be put in mind of the duties those names require.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: let them vse to giue one to the other, their dutifull names and titles, and to eschue and shunne the contrary

items.text: Rule with wisdom and example; fulfill the thing that you command to be done, and be an example in life and deed.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: it is not sufficient for them to declare ... in words and precepts onely, but also in life and deed ... wisedome and example

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Clothe your wife decently as part of providing for your house.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: to cloath their wiues decently

items.text: Bring up your children virtuously.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: to bring vp their children vertuously

items.text: Pay your servants their due.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: to pay their seruants duely

items.text: Love, cherish, and nourish your wife as Christ loved the church and gave himself for it, and as your own body.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: cherish, and nourish his wife, euen as his owne body, and as Christ loued his Church

items.text: Love your wife chiefly because she is your sister in the faith and a fellow heir, not for beauty, wealth, or pleasure.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: loue her for her vertues, as for her shamefastnesse, modestie, chastitie

items.text: Let her perceive and know that you love her simply and faithfully for her own sake, not for utility or pleasure.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: let his wife perceiue and know, that for the good opinion that he hath of her, he doth loue her simply, and faithfully, and not for any vtilitie or pleasure

items.text: Gather and save the goods your husband provides; do not spend them vainly.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: The duty of the husband is to get goods: and of the wife to gather them together, and saue them

items.text: Keep the house and oversee and give order for all things within it.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: the wiues dutie is to keepe the house

items.text: Give account of all household matters to your husband.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: The dutie of the wife, to giue account of all

items.text: Be virtuous and honorable, for the husband's honor depends on you.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: there is no honour within the house, longer then a mans wife is honourable

items.text: When you rule, temper your love with gravity; remember your superiority, but also that she is your fellow and companion.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: when he ruleth, he neither forget to loue, nor to temper his loue with grauitie

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Do not share household secrets or affairs with your parents more than with your spouse; especially in times of discontent.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: they shew no greater secrecie or communication of their houshold affaires to their parents, then mutually each to other

items.text: Do not complain of your spouse to your own parents; if a complaint must be made, let it be to the other's parents.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: if the husband shall complaine to his parents of his wife, or the wife of her husband, such dealing might breed a most dangerous iealousie

items.text: Never seek or even think of divorce; only adultery may separate those united in marriage.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: they neuer seeke, neither once thinke of diuorce

items.text: If separated, remain unmarried and seek to be reconciled; do not continue in separation.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: If the woman depart from her husband, let her remaine vnmarried, or be reconciled to her husband

items.text: Do not forsake an unbelieving spouse who consents to dwell with you; the believer sanctifies the unbeliever.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.
items.quote: If any brother hath a wife that beleeueth not; if she be content to dwell with him; let him not forsake her

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: 1. The dutie of the Husband towards his Wife.

items.text: Love your wife tenderly.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: the husband ought to love his Wife tenderly

items.text: Extend your love to your wife's parents and kinsfolkes for her sake.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: extend his love also vnto her parents and kinsfolkes

items.text: Love your wife's children as your own.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: how much more ought he then to loue her children

items.text: Love your husband's children as your own.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: that she in like case may loue his, if he haue any

items.text: Pray together privately for godly posterity and household concerns.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: they pray together by themselues

items.text: Admonish and teach your wife, as one in authority over her.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: the husband is to admonish the wife, and also to teach her

items.text: Admonish your husband with humility, bringing good reason; he should hear you.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: the wife is to admonish the husband; & in her place admonishing, bringing sufficient reason is to be heard

items.text: Behave with holy familiarity toward your spouse, as with no other.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: holy familiarity which ought to be betwixt man and wife

items.text: Give yourselves to one another bodily for holy procreation; neither has power over own body.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: The husband hath not power ouer his owne body, but the wife &c.

items.text: Use marriage in godliness and purity as God's remedy, not for lustful excess.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, 1
items.quote: vse the benefit of marriage, as an holy ordinance of God, in all godlinesse and puritie

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: A GODLY FORME OF HOVSHOLD GOVERNMENT: CAREFVLLY TO be practised of all Christian Housholders.

items.text: Direct and prescribe what and how in every business; do not let your maids have their own ways for want of skill.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: She must not let her maides haue their owne wayes, for want of skill: but she must be able to direct and prescribe, what, and how, in euery businesse.

items.text: Have good forecast to contrive and dispatch things in due time and order, that necessaries be not wanting when they should be used.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: She must haue a good fore-cast to contriue and dispatch things in due time, and good order, that necessaries be not wanting when they should be vsed.

items.text: Mark the nature of your servants and deal with each as his nature requires, not all with chiding and brawling, which wearies them and makes them careless.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: She must be wise, to marke the nature of her seruants and children, to deale with them as their natures require

items.text: Mark the nature of your children and deal with each as his nature requires, not all with chiding and brawling, which discourages them.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: that wearieth seruants, and maketh often changes, discourageth children

items.text: Keep a diligent eye to the behavior of your servants—their meetings, greetings, words, and looks—lest wantonness and folly break out in your house.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: haue a diligent eye to the behauiour of her seruants, what meetings and greetings, what tickings and toyings, and what words and countenances there be betweene men and maides

items.text: Rise early and stay up late to dispatch your business, and see that no one in your house is idle.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: She riseth before day: and Her candle is not put out by night.

items.text: Set your maids to work and task them to keep them occupied, and suffer none to be idle in your house.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: she setteth her maides to worke: and tasketh them, to keepe them occupied: yea, she suffers none to be idle in her house

items.text: Stir in every place to oversee that duty is done by all hands, and do not just sit and command.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: she must be a stirrer in euery place, to ouersee whether duty be done of all hands, and that in good sort

items.text: Teach, commend, and speak fairly to your servants; show what is amiss gently, and remind them that sloth brings an ill name.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: sometimes gently teaching, sometimes commending, sometimes speaking faire, but neuer brawling: sometimes shewing what is amisse in gentle language

items.text: Lay a diligent eye to your household stuff in every room, that nothing be embezzled, spoiled, or lost for want of looking.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: She must lay a diligent eye to her household-stuffe in euery roome, that nothing be embezelled away, nothing spoiled or lost for want of looking to

items.text: Work with your hands to clothe your family and honor your husband, so that he is known in the gate.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: Her familie is clothed with double, and her husband is knowne in the gate

items.text: Stretch out your hand to the poor and needy from what you yourself have earned, not from your husband's.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
items.quote: She giueth not of her husbands, she giueth of her owne: she found a way to do good without the hurt of her husband.

work: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government
heading: The dutie of Parents towards their children.

items.text: Instruct them in the first principles of Christ's religion as soon as they are able to understand.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, The dutie of Parents towards their children
items.quote: instruct and teach their children the first principles of Christ his Religion, so soone as by age they are able to perceiue and vnderstand

items.text: Teach them to pray to God and rehearse the Apostles' Creed and the Ten Commandments.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, The dutie of Parents towards their children
items.quote: it is their dutie to haue diligent care to haue their children taught to pray to God, and to rehearse the Apostles Creede, and the ten Commendements

items.text: Teach them a short catechism containing the principles of Christian religion as soon as they can speak.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, The dutie of Parents towards their children
items.quote: learning some short Catechisme containing the principles and grounds of Christian religion

items.text: Reprove and correct their vices diligently and early, such as swearing, lying, anger, envy, theft, covetousness, and contempt of parents.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, The dutie of Parents towards their children
items.quote: it is their duty, diligently, and in time to reproue and correct them

items.text: Begin shaping their soul to virtue from infancy.
items.citation: A Godly Forme of Houshold Government, The dutie of Parents towards their children
